'''Pulse mass mines''' were a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] developed by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Deployed from [[pulse mass generator tube]]s onboard [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s, they generated artificial [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]].

==Characteristics==
Pulse mass mines were large silver orbs<ref name="Courtship" /> developed by the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Developed by [[Hapan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] based on the technology used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in their [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]].<ref name="EGVV" /> The mines were deployed in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], usually during combat,<ref name="Courtship" /> to prevent [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] from escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by generating an artificial [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]].<ref name="EGVV" /> They could also be deployed to pull passing ships out of hyperspace and forcing them into normal space.<ref name="SOTG">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Pulse mass mines were carried aboard [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s. Sixteen mines were carried aboard each vessel, with four mines deployable from each of the four [[pulse mass generator tube]]s. The mines could generate an artificial mass shadow for at least a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] before burning out,<ref name="SOTG" /> and in some cases up to ten or fifteen minutes in duration.<ref name="Courtship" />

==History==
The Hapan military made frequent use of this technology and they restricted it to military use.<ref name="SOTG" /> A Hapan fleet deployed pulse mass mines during the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], a risky tactic that blocked hyperspace travel for ten to fifteen minutes.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The mines are referred to as "silver orbs" in ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'',<ref name="Courtship" /> and were identified as "pulse mass mines" in ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.<ref name="EGVV" /> According to ''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]'', the mines lasted for one minute before burning out.<ref name="SOTG" /> The [[Saga Edition]] ''[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|Starships of the Galaxy]]'' revises this to ten minutes,<ref name="Saga-SOTG">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> which is in line with the description of the weapon given in ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.<ref name="Courtship" />
